rows.micah_quote: Foster and Scheinost’s temporal wave model offers a strong parallel to this concept. They describe how waves in the brain operate on different timescales depending on the task, with faster waves handling perception and slower waves managing memory and attention. This mirrors SAN’s theory of temporal binding, where low- and high-frequency oscillations work together to bind information across time, creating a cohesive state of awareness.
